00024|   MtpCost c = i8_head ? int8_head() : bf16_head();
00025|   while (c.verify.size() < 8) c.verify.push_back(c.verify.back() + 0.22);

00054| std::vector<double> parse_list(const std::string& key, const std::string& text) {
00055|   std::vector<double> out;
00056|   size_t at = 0;
00057|   while (at <= text.size()) {
00058|     const size_t comma = std::min(text.find(',', at), text.size());
00059|     const std::string item = text.substr(at, comma - at);
00060|     if (item.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("--mtp-cost: empty value in '" + key + "'");
00061|     char* end = nullptr;
00062|     errno = 0;
00063|     const double v = std::strtod(item.c_str(), &end);
00064|     if (errno != 0 || end != item.c_str() + item.size() || !std::isfinite(v) || v <= 0)
00065|       throw std::invalid_argument("--mtp-cost: '" + item + "' is not a positive cost");
00066|     out.push_back(v);
00067|     at = comma + 1;
00068|   }
00069|   return out;
00070| }
00071| 
00072| }  // namespace

00074| MtpCost MtpCost::parse(const std::string& text, const MtpCost& base) {
00075|   MtpCost c = base;
00076|   bool seen_verify = false, seen_draft = false;
00077|   size_t at = 0;
00078|   if (text.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("--mtp-cost: empty");
00079|   while (at <= text.size()) {
00080|     const size_t semi = std::min(text.find(';', at), text.size());
00081|     const std::string part = text.substr(at, semi - at);
00082|     const size_t eq = part.find('=');
00083|     if (eq == std::string::npos)
00084|       throw std::invalid_argument("--mtp-cost: expected verify=... or draft=..., got '" + part + "'");
00085|     const std::string key = part.substr(0, eq);
00086|     std::vector<double> v = parse_list(key, part.substr(eq + 1));
00087|     if (key == "verify" && !seen_verify) {
00088|       seen_verify = true;
00089|       c.verify = std::move(v);
00090|     } else if (key == "draft" && !seen_draft) {
00091|       seen_draft = true;
00092|       c.draft = std::move(v);
00093|     } else {
00094|       throw std::invalid_argument("--mtp-cost: unknown or repeated key '" + key + "'");
00095|     }
00096|     at = semi + 1;
00097|   }
00098|   return c;
00099| }
